instruction: Make Verdana the default font in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font in LibreOffice Writer to Verdana. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu configuration file to verify the default font setting has been changed to 'Verdana'. This uses the existing find_default_font metric function.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if default font is set to Verdana, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts state from LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) which is the authoritative source for default font settings
XML parsing logic uses correct XPath to locate the default font setting: /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont with prop[@oor:name='Standard']
Binary comparison (exact string match) is appropriate for font name verification
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting Verdana as default font, evaluator checks exactly that requirement
Expected value 'Verdana' correctly matches the instruction requirement
Proper edge case handling: returns 0 for missing files or parsing errors, which correctly indicates task failure
